name: load_nifti
description: Load a NIfTI volume and return its metadata (shape, affine, voxel spacing).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Filesystem path to a .nii or .nii.gz file.

fields.name: affine
fields.description: 4x4 NIfTI affine matrix mapping voxel index → world (mm) coordinates.

fields.name: dtype
fields.description: Numpy dtype string of the volume data.
